title: John Marston's last stand at Beecher's Hope in Red Dead
subject: marston
description:
Was John's sacrifice worth it? 👇

The ending of Red Dead Redemption: John Marston's final choice at his ranch, and what Jack did in 1914. Spoilers for Red Dead Redemption.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: John Marston walked out of his own barn knowing he would die.
Back at Beecher's Hope, he had Abigail and Jack again, and a few quiet months.
Then Edgar Ross came back with soldiers. Uncle was shot in the first attack.
John put his wife and son on a horse, then faced the line of guns alone.
Rockstar named that mission The Last Enemy That Shall Be Destroyed.
In 1914, a nineteen-year-old Jack found the retired Ross hunting ducks by the San Luis River.
Jack drew first, and the Marston name belonged to an outlaw again.
